## Libre Photography

Collection: [michaelsynan/libre-photography](https://github.com/michaelsynan/libre-photography), pinned to commit `aa71514524d362ed55d9f24130c19777152c672c`. Collection owner: Michael Synan. A separate photographer identity is not supplied by the individual image files, so visible credit uses the collection name.

The collection's own [About page at this commit](https://github.com/michaelsynan/libre-photography/blob/aa71514524d362ed55d9f24130c19777152c672c/pages/about.vue) expressly states:

> All photos on our site are CC0 licensed, meaning they are free for personal and commercial use with no attribution required.

It describes the collection as focused on New York City. The UK and Asia-Pacific panels therefore **do not claim to depict those regional locations**. Their captions and alt text identify them as illustrative photography. The existing Europe workspace has no Paris label or claim of ION occupancy.

Saved source-page evidence: [libre-photography-about.vue.txt](libre-photography-about.vue.txt). This explicit photo dedication, rather than a code licence or inferred public-domain label, is the basis for use. [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

Original image URLs:

- [Commercial architecture / 1.jpg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/michaelsynan/libre-photography/aa71514524d362ed55d9f24130c19777152c672c/public/1.jpg)
- [Urban landscape / 18.webp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/michaelsynan/libre-photography/aa71514524d362ed55d9f24130c19777152c672c/public/18.webp)
- [New York waterfront / 26.webp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/michaelsynan/libre-photography/aa71514524d362ed55d9f24130c19777152c672c/public/26.webp)

Local exports resize and compress the originals to WebP. No AI generation or retouching was applied. Original downloads were inspected and retained in the execution workspace; the URLs above provide reproducible sources.

## Existing imagery

The About office photo, original Dubai footage/poster and Saudi photography predate this sourcing task. This change makes no new licence assertion about those supplied assets. The office photo remains labelled as illustrative, and no identifiable stock subject is presented as an ION employee.
